transcript: Speaker A (AI): प्रिया, तुम्हारी मम्मी कहाँ हैं? [Priya, where is your mother?] Speaker B (Human): My mother go to parlor. [So what should I say?] Speaker A (AI): My mother went to the parlor. Speaker B (Human): My mother went to the parlor. Speaker A (AI): एकदम सही! कभी AI टीचर ट्राई किया है? [Exactly right! on_screen_text: यह AI टीचर सिर्फ 1 रुपये में ENGLISH सिखाने का वादा करती है। [This AI teacher promises to teach English for just 1 rupee.] Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play.
summary: An AI avatar corrects a student's English grammar in a split-screen format, highlighting the benefits of non-judgmental learning. The ad promotes the SpeakEasy app as an affordable, effective way to practice daily and improve fluency. It ends with a call to action to download the app from Google Play.
